description: Golden set for the Sponsor Renewal Desk (Week 3): six sponsors chosen to exercise different paths. Figures are not stored here: the evaluation recomputes each fact sheet from the data, so a pack is checked against the real numbers. 'allowed_moves' is the reasonable range of recommendations given the results (upgrade, keep or downgrade the current package).

sponsors.why: 83% of target overall with 4 of 7 events below 80%: the pack must name the weak events and must not upsell.
Did not renew last time and has no deck: the 'What we promised' section must say no record was found.
Just under target (98%) with one event below 80%: an upgrade would not be justified.
116% of target and a deck that asks to move up a tier: the pack should cite the deck.
Six events, one below 80%, and a deck: the longest fact sheet in the set.
164% of target with no weak event: a downgrade would not be justified.
